contract_traces.trace: Private UnitInterval(f32) admits only finite [0,1], including valid zero/one and native signed zero. NonnegativeSpeed endpoints remain finite and >=0. checked_lerp now accepts UnitInterval and extracts fraction only inside scalar interpolation self+(other-self)*factor, with same textual operation order. Result is admitted through from_metres_per_second; nonfinite result becomes SpeedError::Overflow, negative result stays distinguished. No infallible arithmetic or unchecked output retention is introduced; no raw forwarding overload/backward-compatibility path.
